result:
Round 188 is planned: STORE-1c, the store header and footer. Round 187 passed in C's real-browser check with 0 bugs and is published as `cb24362`, so STORE-1b is now marked მზადაა. Decision: **CONTINUE**. I changed only planning files; the store tree is clean. The advisor was available, and I consulted it twice.

**Why STORE-1c and not regression:** the last regression round was on 2026-10-24. Today is 10-26, two days later, so the regression round is not due until the first planning on or after 10-27 (expected to be round 189). Round 187's pre-written outcome also points to STORE-1c. There are no open Critical, High or Medium findings.

**Round 188 task (starts from `cb24362`; A may edit 4 existing files and add 2 new ones):**
- **Header, desktop and mobile:** the menu becomes Collections · Studio · Free Samples · About.
  - "Collections" points to `/store` because no collections page exists (ruling R56).
  - "Studio" goes to `/studio-lab` without the "Demo" badge. The Studio page itself still shows its demo badge and its "Demo workspace" title, so `/studio-lab` stays a public demo.
  - Gift Cards and Hire Us leave the header but stay in the footer (R57).
  - Free Samples stays, since it is on Saba's keep-list.
- **One h1 per page:** the "CZABA" logo is currently an `<h1>`, so every store page has two. It becomes a plain, non-gradient `<span>` (R59).
- **Footer:** "Czaba Music" becomes "CZABA" (R58).
- **Also in this round:** the end-to-end navigation test's list of header links is updated so it stops skipping silently, and doc 154's stale status is fixed.
- **Kept unchanged on purpose:** the sign-in/account part of the header stays byte-identical, including the "Sign In" casing (R60). All five rulings can be vetoed by Saba.
- **Tests:** A writes a new test file. Its header, footer and server-render checks must fail on the old code, and its sign-in checks must pass on both old and new code.
- **C's browser checks** at 1440×900, 1280×720 and 375×812 against the mock API:
  - the menu on desktop and mobile, the h1 count on 8 pages, logo contrast, and the footer;
  - the keep-list items, and a before/after screenshot diff limited to the header and the footer line;
  - the navigation e2e test, purchase protection and the Studio look;
  - scope, the failing-on-old-code runs, the code review, and network and hydration errors.

**Backlog and status updates:**
- Round 187 is recorded as passed and published (`cb24362`).
- C-R187-I1 is added to STORE-1d's acceptance: the entrance loader currently covers the home-page card Play button for about 3–5 seconds, and it must not.
- C's correction is recorded: `/store` has no preview buttons, so the regression round checks the preview button on the home-page cards instead.
- The reviewer's and A's notes are recorded as signals, not scheduled work.
- Two new Lows go to the deferred polish list (now 266 entries):
  - the play/pause icons lack `aria-hidden`;
  - one product-card badge uses colour tokens that don't exist. That badge is on the keep-list, so it gets a restyle only.
- STORE-1c and the home-page preview-button check are added to the regression round's scope.

The advisor's final review caught problems in my task text, which I fixed before handing off:
- The e2e test filter would have matched no tests.
- The h1 count is now taken outside the loader overlay. I confirmed the home-page loader renders nothing on the server, so the server-rendered page should show one h1 after the fix (two today).
- The scope check now counts only added or removed lines.
- The baseline screenshot paths are now named.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop`:
- `current-task.md`
- `tasks/round-187.md` (archived previous task)
- `b-round-187.md`
- `b-next.json`
- `backlog.json` (version 173)
- `feature-status.md`
- the baseline files `b-round-187-r188-*`
